Lia (PM): Quick planning thread for next-quarter console observability work. We gotten a handful of customer asks that cluster around: cost visibility per-route, lightweight tracing hooks (low overhead + easy span linking), and error/regression analytics. Need to nail MVP scope + launch gates.

Maya (Product): Sales flagged Acme + FinSafe specifically. Cost-per-route and a simple UI to compare hosted vs dedicated are purchase blockers right now.

Devin (Eng): Engineering constraints: ingestion and storage are the biggest drivers. We can produce a metrics-first dashboard quickly, but full per-span indexing with 30d retention is heavy. Recommend phased delivery.

Sanjay (SRE): Agree. We should define SLO targets up front: dashboard render p95 <200ms, sampling path add <15ms p95 when enabled. Those numbers will shape infra and perf tests.

Lia (PM): My proposed MVP surface: 1) cost-by-route widget (top-N routes + hosted/dedicated toggle), 2) tracing hooks (configurable low-overhead sampling + span attach API), 3) error-regression alerts (route+model-version grouping, basic anomaly detection). Launch gates: end-to-end demo on Acme dataset, SLO perf verification, and documented retention/PII controls. Objections?

Maya (Product): No objections. Can we limit cost widget to top-10 routes initially? Less backend work and addresses most customers.

Devin (Eng): Top-10 routes is workable. For tracing sampling, propose initial default config so we don't blow up storage:

```
sampling:
  global_rate: 0.01  # 1% of requests
  prioritized_routes:
    - /v1/generate
    - /v1/embeddings
  max_spans_per_trace: 50
```

Customers on Dedicated can opt into higher sampling.

Sanjay (SRE): For error analytics we should be explicit about signal rules: aggregate by route+model-version, anomaly_threshold=0.85, alert debounce/burn-in window to reduce noise. Also link alerts to our eval/metric dashboards so product teams can run regressions.

Lia (PM): Two tradeoffs to decide: retention (14d hosted vs 30d dedicated/private) and default sampling (1% vs 0.1%). FinSafe asked for 30d + audit logs. Should that be dedicated/private-only?

Maya (Product): Recommend 30d for Dedicated/Private, 14d for Hosted to control costs. Expose an upgrade path in UI with an estimated monthly price delta.

Devin (Eng): Implementation notes: UI should show estimated monthly token + trace storage delta before confirming retention upgrade. Backend: we can reuse prefix/KV caching to avoid re-ingesting identical request bodies for cost calculations and reduce storage.

Sanjay (SRE): Also need KMS metadata support and retention settings exposed for Private customers. That's a gating requirement for regulated customers.

Lia (PM): OK looks like rough consensus. Action items:
- Lia: write acceptance criteria + demo runbook for Acme (due Tue)
- Devin: spike for trace-hooks sampling perf impact (due Fri)
- Maya: customer-impact doc + pricing sketch for retention tiers (due Wed)
- Sanjay: SLO test plan + infra cost estimate for 14d vs 30d (due Fri)

Devin (Eng): I'll post a short benchmark here when done.

observability-bot: deploy-bot: canary "trace-hooks-lite" started in staging at 1762503000, job=canary-traces-02, status=running.

Maya (Product): Great. If canary is stable can we book a demo slot with Acme next week?

Devin (Eng): Preliminary staging perf: sampling at 1% adds ~6-8ms p95 to sampled request path. I'll attach full logs tomorrow.

Sanjay (SRE): FYI: rough storage delta 14d->30d at current sampling ~= +28% monthly storage cost. Adding that to the cost doc.

Lia (PM): Thanks all. I'll synthesize the acceptance checklist and post. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock the MVP and start tickets. :thumbsup:
